warning: This file describes PLANNED state. The previous version documented Hostinger MX + SendGrid + BIMI as if they were live; a live DNS query on 2026-10-24 showed none of them were. Always verify against DNS, not against this file. Run: node scripts/verify_dns_records.js

observed.verdict: No DKIM, no DMARC, and SPF authorises only the forwarding host. Transactional mail sent through Resend/Brevo fails authentication.

outbound.provider: Resend or Brevo (Worker uses whichever API key is set)
outbound.note: Copy the DKIM value from the provider dashboard after adding the domain. DKIM keys are per-account and must never be invented.

dmarc.phase1_monitor: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@sr-coresync.com; ruf=mailto:security@sr-coresync.com; fo=1; pct=100
dmarc.phase2_enforce: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; sp=quarantine; adkim=s; aspf=s; rua=mailto:dmarc@sr-coresync.com; pct=100
dmarc.phase3_reject: v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=reject; adkim=s; aspf=s; rua=mailto:dmarc@sr-coresync.com; pct=100

bimi.reason: BIMI needs DMARC enforcement plus a paid VMC certificate and an SVG Tiny PS logo. The current sr-core-emblem.svg is not Tiny PS, and a plain SVG does not render in Gmail.
